Content: Chat streaming flows from IChatProvider.StreamAsync through MemoryChatAgent.StreamAsync into Chat.razor. Providers emit ChatProviderChunk content and thinking deltas; MemoryChatAgent accumulates them, builds final MemoryChatResponse context/write metadata, and emits a final MemoryChatStreamUpdate. Chat.razor mutates the pending assistant turn in place, tracks streamed character count and elapsed time, saves in-flight turns periodically, and clears the progress state before final persistence so the flashing loading bar does not linger. Thinking deltas set ChatTurnState.ThinkingActive, render as a details block above the visible response, open while active, and use app.css animation classes for a live activity dot and caret. Ollama thinking can come from a message.thinking field or from split <think> tags; GitHub reasoning maps from SDK reasoning events.
Title: Chat Streaming and Thinking Blocks
